newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Chances of Brazil Santos port strike slim - union.
newsitem.headline: Chances of Brazil Santos port strike slim - union.

text.p: Chances are clim for a strike by stevedores at Brazil's port of Santos thanks to progress in talks between union representatives and local steel firm Cosipa, a union official said.
"There is only area left to be sorted out. There is virtually no possibility of a strike now," said Antonio Pinheiro, first treasurer at the local stevedores union.
Union members staged two strikes at the port last month in protest against a decision by Cosipa to use its own workers to load and unload vessels at its private terminal.
But a series of discussions have led to a proposal by union leaders which would reduce total Cosipa's costs by around 60 percent.
The two sides are to meet at 1400 local/1700 GMT today.
"I think that today we may have a final position," a Cosipa spokeswoman said. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
